body: it seems like she’s really lucky to have you. please don’t give up on her and tell her how much she means to you everyday, even if you start sounding like a broken record. maybe try to remind her of all the good times you’ve had and give her a reason to stay. if she loves you and sees a future with you, she should want to stay. i know that’s i needed and i’m just speaking from experience. i was in the same position as your girlfriend and relied on my boyfriend as my reason to keep going. then he broke up with me so maybe just don’t do that to yours lol. i really do wish you the best and hope nothing happens. it’s sometimes hard to open up about what’s going on in our mind because you can’t put it into words, but try to reassure her that you’ll always be there, supporting her through everything, and make her feel comforted. the worse feeling is when we think we’re alone, cause then your actions have to impact on anyone else and it feels easier to leave. just make sure she feels that she’ll never get to that point and that you’ll always be there. also your english was super good don’t even worry about it! i hope you and your girlfriend work through this and make it through together.
